mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% MoM and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in 3 months and the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises by more than 0.5% MoM and the S&P 500 still produces negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases below 4% and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls by more than 0.3pp in 3 months and the S&P 500 still produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS rises by more than 0.5% MoM and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS rises by more than 0.5% MoM and the S&P 500 still produces negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
